- Knock Yourself: Allows you to knock yourself out instead of waiting for another player to do it for you.

- Instant Log: Immediately log you from the game if you're not in danger.
- Spectate Players: Allows you to spectate other players in the game.
- Remove Kill Bricks: Remove all kill bricks from the game so you don't have to worry about it.
- No Fall Damage: You will not take fall damage no matter how high you fall.
- No Sun Check: You will not be affected by the sun no matter how long you stay in its light.
- No Dash Cooldown: You can dash infinitely without any cooldown.

- Change Mana Color: Changes the color of your mana.
